description: Management has not established structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in pursuit of objectives.
applicability: Applies to all entities when organizational structure is undefined, reporting relationships are unclear, roles and responsibilities are not documented, authority levels are ambiguous, or there is inadequate segregation of duties.

metadata.detection_notes: Review organizational charts, role descriptions, delegation of authority policies, RACI matrices, and segregation of duties documentation. Look for absence of documented structure, conflicting authorities, or unclear accountability.
